title: Formally-Verifiable and Human-Interpretable RTL Generation with LLM-Guided Stepwise Refinement
abstract: arXiv:2606.19387v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are accelerating register-transfer level (RTL) development, but ensuring the correctness of generated designs remains a major challenge. Existing LLM-driven workflows rely heavily on simulation-based verification, which provides limited correctness guarantees, and often offer little insight into the design decisions behind the generated RTL. We present a framework for LLM-guided, correct-by-construction RTL generation that combines the generative capabilities of LLMs with the mathematical rigor of stepwise refinement. The framework translates natural-language requirements into a formal hardware contract and progressively refines the contract into an implementation. At each refinement step, the LLM proposes a design decision, while the refinement engine applies the corresponding transformation only after formally verifying its correctness. translated_title: 基于LLM引导的逐步精化实现可形式化验证且人类可理解的RTL生成
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）正在加速寄存器传输级（RTL）的开发，但确保生成设计的正确性仍然是一个重大挑战。现有的LLM驱动的工作流程严重依赖基于仿真的验证，这只能提供有限的正确性保证，且通常对生成的RTL背后的设计决策缺乏洞察。我们提出了一个LLM引导的、构造即正确的RTL生成框架，该框架将LLM的生成能力与逐步精化的数学严谨性相结合。该框架将自然语言需求转化为形式化硬件契约，并逐步将契约精化为实现。在每个精化步骤中，由LLM提出设计决策，而精化引擎仅在形式化验证其正确性之后才应用相应的转换。最终得到的程序针对契约进行形式化验证（原文摘要至此截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出将大语言模型的生成能力与逐步精化的形式化方法相结合，把自然语言需求转化为形式化硬件契约，并在每一步设计决策变换前进行形式化验证，从而实现构造即正确、可形式化验证且人类可理解的RTL硬件代码生成。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a framework that combines LLM generative capabilities with mathematically rigorous stepwise refinement, converting natural-language requirements into formal hardware contracts and formally verifying each design transformation, thereby achieving correct-by-construction, formally-verifiable, and human-interpretable RTL generation.
